pasos.titulo: The trade war opens a window
pasos.texto: After China's 2025 tariffs, the United States went from {antes}% to {despues}% of the pork offal China buys. Other suppliers are taking that space.
pasos.descripcion: Chart: monthly US share of the value of China's pork-offal imports, 2015–2026, with the 2025 cut highlighted.

pasos.texto: In 2018 the US lost {p18} share points, and in 2020 it won back {p20} when China began granting exclusions. In recent months it is back to about {ultimos}% of the value.
pasos.descripcion: Chart: the same series with the 2018 and 2020 cuts highlighted (interrupted time series).

pasos.texto: China imported {toneladas} million tonnes of frozen pork offal in {anio}. What Ecuador could place, according to the model: {min} to {max} tonnes a year, just {pct}%.
pasos.descripcion: Chart: China's yearly pork-offal imports, 2018–2025, next to an almost invisible bar for what Ecuador could place.

pasos.titulo: …but Ecuador isn't allowed to sell to it
pasos.texto: The WOAH recognizes only the Galápagos as free of classical swine fever. Brazil and Costa Rica were free when they got in, and it took them about 7 years from protocol to first shipment. Ecuador has no protocol yet.
pasos.descripcion: Chart: years from the start of the sanitary protocol to the first shipment to China: Brazil 7, Costa Rica 7; Chile got in in 2011; Ecuador has no protocol.

pasos.titulo: And every kilo would lose money
pasos.texto: China pays {fob} USD per kilo; the offal is worth {offal} in Ecuador, and processing, freezing and shipping it to port costs {costos}. Margin: {margen} USD per kilo. With a negative margin, more volume means more loss: NPV is negative in {neg} of {de} scenarios.
pasos.descripcion: Waterfall chart: price in China minus local value of the offal minus costs gives a negative margin per kilo.

pasos.titulo: Decision: don't invest today. These five signals reopen it
pasos.texto: It takes one economic condition (cheaper offal or a better price in China) plus both access conditions (free zone and protocol). The dashboard recomputes them on every pipeline run.
pasos.descripcion: List of the five triggers and their status: four not met and foot-and-mouth disease freedom without vaccination on track.
